description: Case-name metadata search over the local CourtListener mirror. Punctuation-insensitive trigram match on the case name ("Brown v board of education" matches "Brown v. Board of Education"). Returns cluster rows: id, case_name, case_name_short, date_filed, precedential_status, citation_count, slug. Metadata only: no opinion text, and not concept search (it finds a case by its name, not by what it is about). Case law in this mirror ends 2026-09-30 (exact scan of all 10,174,547 case records): a thin or empty result for recent authority means the collection ends there, not that no such case exists. Every response carries a "note" stating that response’s source and coverage limits.

court.description: filter to CourtListener court ids (e.g. ["scotus","ca10"]); OR within the list

date_filed_after.description: only cases filed on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_filed_before.description: only cases filed on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

precedential_status.description: filter by precedential status; OR within the list

name: search
title: Search case names
